column1: # Copy this file, fill in the header from the review's test-system page, then
# add one row per bar on its charts. Run:  npm run perf:import -- <this file>
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Columns are tab OR comma separated.
# `up` is the upsampling mode: native | ultra-quality | quality | balanced |
# performance. It is per ROW because review parcours set it per GAME. There is
# no default — a row nobody stated a render scale for is rejected, not guessed,
# because an upscaled frame rate is not a native one.
# `low` is optional and must stay LAST.
game        res     preset  up       part               avg    low
